snippet.title: NTE - Version 1.1 Preview Special Program
snippet.description:
The NTE Version 1.1 Preview Special Program goes live on May 23, 2026 at 19:30 (UTC+8)!
Welcome to the supernatural city of Hethereau, where anomalies are the new normal!

NTE V1.1 "Dreamwalk Corridor" launches June 3 with new Limited S-Class Characters Lacrimosa & Chaos. Download today: https://nte.onelink.me/9g76/ia3mr5k3

Follow our official channels for the latest on NTE!
X: https://x.com/NTE_GL
